name: Chocolate Hazelnut Yule Log with Meringue Mushrooms
subtitle: A festive chocolate roulade with hazelnut filling and crisp meringue mushrooms.
description: Bake a cocoa sponge, fill it with chocolate-hazelnut mixture, coat it with cocoa buttercream, and finish with meringue mushrooms, toasted hazelnuts, and pumpkin seeds.

ingredients.item: cocoa powder plus extra for dusting

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a shallow jelly-roll pan with parchment. For the meringue mushrooms, beat the egg whites to stiff peaks, gradually add the caster sugar, and continue until thick and glossy. Fold in the icing sugar, pipe mushroom caps and stems onto a lined tray, and bake at 250°F until dry and firm, about 60 minutes.

Separate the five eggs. Beat the yolks with the caster sugar and vanilla until pale, then mix in the chocolate hazelnut spread. Fold in the plain flour, cocoa powder, toasted hazelnuts, and chopped pumpkin seeds.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks and fold them gently into the chocolate mixture. Spread the batter in the prepared pan and bake until puffed and set; the center should reach 160°F for egg safety.
Cool the sponge briefly, dust it with cocoa, and roll it up in the parchment while warm. Let it cool completely, then unroll it.
Stir the melted dark chocolate into the chocolate hazelnut spread. Spread the mixture over the sponge, roll it up again, and chill until set, about 15 minutes.
Beat the softened butter until smooth. Gradually add the icing sugar, milk, vanilla, and cocoa powder, then whisk until light and creamy.
Trim the ends of the roll and cut one piece on an angle to form a branch. Attach it to the log with a little buttercream, then coat the log and branch with the remaining buttercream.
Shape bark lines with a spatula or fork. Decorate with the meringue mushrooms, hazelnuts, and pumpkin seeds, then dust with the reserved cocoa powder.
